findings.evidence: template/scripts/project_publish.py:519 selects lifecycle mode, but the version-2 shared-manifest branch at lines 550–555 unconditionally imports requirement_composition and calls publish_composition without checking selected_mode. validate_shared_manifest (lines 452–457) accepts version-2 manifests without a source-contract check. requirement_composition.py:15 imports lifecycle_workers at module level, and publish_composition imports publication_queue at lines 219–220. Thus a downstream checkout publishing a valid committed version-2 manifest reaches coordinator logic despite selecting portable mode; with those modules absent, publication fails with an import error instead of explicitly rejecting the unsupported request.
findings.summary: Shared Requirement publication can still load and invoke the coordinator after selecting portable mode.
